review: Chorus is v2 (printed label 1); C: repeats 2:1-2:4. "Near the Cross" hymn. as-Salib → הַצְּלָב, al-Fadi → הַפּוֹדֶה, fidya → פִּדְיוֹן per glossary. 2:1 internal " · " renders the Arabic comma between the two repeated phrases; 2:1's two half-phrases are one printed line. 2:3 stays short (Arabic "في حياتي وكذا" is short) and 2:4 stays long ("بعد دفن القبر" → אַחֲרֵי הַקְּבוּרָה בַּקֶּבֶר); the redundant "also" was removed from 2:4 since 2:3 already has וְכֵן גַּם. 3:2 subject "blood" carries the verb from 3:1 ("erased my iniquity").
